snippet.title: Crunchball 3000
snippet.description:
Trailer for my upcoming game: "Cruncball 3000"

Two teams of ten compete against each other to get the ball in their opponents goal in the futuristic sports game. Play to try and win your way up the 4 divisions to become world champions.

Features:

32 Teams 
320 Players each with their own unique names and abilities 
Customize all team colors, names and player names 
Train your players, upgrade their equipment, transfer players and even give the performance enhancing drugs at the risk of a fine
